YOUR INFORMATION

Know what happens
before you share.

Understand what you send and how your consultation request is handled.

Website operator

This website is operated by Hymen.ca Inc.

Reading the guides

You can read the website without submitting personal information. The site does not use advertising pixels, analytics or session replay.

Sending a consultation request

When you submit, your chosen topic, location, name, email, optional phone number, permissions and page language are sent to Formspree for the hymen.ca form account. Formspree processes the submission and delivers notifications according to that account’s settings.

Provide only contact details and your general area of interest. Do not send medical records, photographs or intimate history through this form.

Your choices

Contact consent is required to send a request. Voicemail permission is optional and separate. No marketing consent is requested. Ask the team replying to your enquiry to stop contacting you or to address questions about your submitted information.

Storage and external services

This site does not save form entries in cookies, local storage or page URLs. Successful submission clears the form. With JavaScript enabled, unsent entries are cleared when you leave the page; your browser may separately offer autofill. Submitted records are managed through the Formspree account and its configured recipients, not erased by clearing this page.

Provider links take you to independent websites with their own privacy practices. Opening a provider link does not send your form entries.
